# Custom rules only

<!-- Generated by tools/rules-md.ts from rules/. Do not edit; run `npm run rules:md`. -->

This fork ships no production rules.
Author rules in `.jev-lint/rules/`, or pass explicit files or directories with `-R`.
Test-only suites in `test/fixtures/rules/` are never default rule sources and are excluded from the npm package.
See [the authoring reference](docs/reference.md) and [fork differences](docs/upstream-differences.md).
